bull_bear.body:
- Slide titled "Strengthening Our Balance Sheet": net debt Rs 4,719 Cr at Jun-26 vs Rs 4,824 Cr at Mar-26 - "Despite the capex, net debt reduced to Rs 4,719 Cr, supported by robust operational FCF".
- Debt mix shifted short to long: ST debt Rs 440 Cr at Jun-26 (vs Rs 1,060 Cr at Mar-26) and LT debt Rs 4,617 Cr (vs Rs 4,426 Cr); total debt Rs 5,057 Cr vs Rs 5,486 Cr.
- Leverage ratios improved: Net Debt/Equity 0.60x at Jun-26 vs 0.65x at Mar-26 (change -0.05); Net Debt/EBITDA 1.40x vs 2.86x (change 1.46).
- Shareholding stable at the top: Promoters 45.6% at both 31-Mar-26 and 30-Jun-26, with "FII + DII = 24.7% (vs 23.5%)"; deck's shareholder-value slide labels the market-cap series "CAGR 72% Value Creation" (Rs 669 Cr at Mar-20 to Rs 19,668 Cr at Jun-26, market cap as on the last day of the period).

business.body:
- Three verticals (Mining Chemicals/TAN, Industrial Chemicals, Crop Nutrition) built on an "Integrated value chain of GAS to Downstream Products"; deck cites 40+ years experience, 6 manufacturing sites, 2,300+ employees and market capitalisation of "US$ ~2.07 billion (as on 30 Jun 2026)".
- Mining Chemicals: "India's only manufacturer of High Density, Low Density & Medical Grade Ammonium Nitrate", dominant market share (~39% domestic in TAN), plants on both East and West coasts, and value-chain integration "forward into explosives, backward into ammonia".
- Industrial Chemicals: "Largest manufacturer of Nitric Acid in South East Asia" and one of the leading manufacturers/marketers of Iso Propyl Alcohol; deck states domestic share of "62% in CNA, 27% in DNA, 10% in Merchant IPA".
- Crop Nutrition: "Market leader in specialty and water-soluble fertilisers in India", "India's only manufacturer of Prilled NP 24:24:0", "India's Largest manufacturer of Bentonite Sulphur", and the only producer of crop-specific NPK nutrient solutions with micronutrients and Nutrient Unlock Technology (NUT); 'Mahadhan' brand strong in Maharashtra, Karnataka and Gujarat.
- Deck's key takeaway slide: "Establishing market dominance through strategic initiatives", "Market leadership in most categories" and capex "strategically positioned for emerging opportunities".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Demerger] Deck shows "Corporate Structure post Demerger" with DFPCL and MAL, listing Mining Chemicals (TAN), Crop Nutrition, Industrial Chemicals, Value Added Real Estate (VARE), Ammonia, subsidiaries CCPL (mining explosives) and DGCPL (LNG trading), plus blasting services in Australia; the deck does not explain the demerger terms.
- [Regulation - PESO] TAN production and dispatch were disrupted by "PESO ANRS portal changes", the stated reason for the 12% YoY volume decline.
- [Regulation - RGP quota] Government of India curtailed the RGP quota (linked by the deck to the US-Iran conflict), cutting IPA volumes 76% YoY and forcing a shutdown; outlook says relaxation of the quota improves supply availability "however, correction in domestic IPA prices is expected".
- [Demand outlook] Monsoon-driven slowdown in mining/infrastructure may hit Q2 TAN demand though elevated FGAN prices should support margin; for Crop Nutrition, El Nino impact expected to be limited with "only 12 of 44 core districts likely to receive below-normal rainfall".
- [Gas] Margin support attributed to an Equinor gas arrangement; the deck gives no contract volume, tenure or pricing.
